findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "zeekeo_create_campaign" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates a Zeekeo LinkedIn campaign: sends a connection invite using invite_template_id, and optionally — if followup_template_id is given — waits for the invite…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_backlinks, get_sitemap, get_page_seo, get_page_performance, get_site_health, get_schema_markup, get_keyword_rankings, list_rank_change_alerts, get_rank_alert_settings, get_gsc_sitemaps, get_gsc_url_inspection, get_gsc_page_segment, get_google_ads_keyword_ideas, outreach_create_campaign, outreach_add_contacts, zeekeo_create_campaign, submit_indexnow_urls · Private data: outreach_create_campaign, outreach_add_contacts, outreach_launch_campaign, outreach_suggest_prospects, outreach_list_campaigns, provision_indexnow_key, submit_indexnow_urls · Public sink: list_rank_change_alerts, get_rank_alert_settings, update_rank_alert_settings, outreach_create_campaign, outreach_add_contacts, outreach_launch_campaign, outreach_suggest_prospects, outreach_sending_status, outreach_configure_sending, outreach_resume_campaign, zeekeo_send_message, provision_indexnow_key, submit_indexnow_urls · Destructive: get_platform_trends, list_rank_tracking_sites, get_gsc_page_trend, outreach_suggest_prospects.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
